risk_classification.rationale: Terminology and nomenclature reference: dictionary senses, IUPAC names, a database synonym list and a German lexicon entry. It states which species words are attached to; it gives no handling, toxicity, exposure, medical, regulatory, industrial-procedure or commercial guidance. Safety, medical and industrial-use claims are excluded by the KO and named as outside the reference.
